Hi Sara — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + proposed Mutual Action Plan items focused on vendor onboarding so procurement can move forward without surprises.

Top-line MAP milestones (vendor onboarding):
- M1: Vendor packet submitted (W-9, ACH/banking form, tax ID) — owner: Brightline procurement
- M2: Ariba / Coupa supplier request submitted (or vendor code provided) — owner: Brightline procurement; Redwood to supply vendor packet template
- M3: Legal & payment terms sign-off (SOW/Order + any redlines) — owner: Redwood legal (Stephanie) / Brightline legal
- M4: Production access + billing account set up — owner: Redwood (CS + Ops)

Dependencies: SOC2/infosec questionnaire answers (we'll attach our standard packet), vetted bank remit details (Brightline to provide), and signed order/PO.

Target close date: May 21, 2026 (tentative — happy to compress if procurement can prioritize Ariba enrollment).

Immediate next steps I will take: attach a one-page MAP and our W-9 & vendor packet template; loop in our Sales Ops (Marcus) and Legal (Stephanie) to own backend steps. Please confirm Brightline procurement contact (or Ariba supplier ID if you already have one) and whether you prefer DocuSign or a procurement portal for the signature flow.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP outline), Redwood_W9.pdf (fillable).

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum here.

—Camila
